newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS rejigs "focus" stock list.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS rejigs "focus" stock list.

text.p: Equity strategists at brokerage UBS said on Monday they had rejigged their European "focus" list of recommended stocks with the addition of Abbey National Plc, Arbed, Copenhagen Airport, Enterprise Oil Plc, PowerGen Plc and Stork.
Knocked off the list were Banco Bilbao Vizcaya, British Land Plc, Greenalls Group Plc, Ladbroke Group Plc, Mannesmann AG and VNU.
"Overall these changes reinforce our preference for cyclicals and defensive, asset-backed situations," said UBS strategist Mark Howdle.
He said Abbey provided a play on the UK housing market and was expected to outperform the UK bank sector and that Copenhagen Airport should benefit from rising European air traffic.

Arbed was a steel restructuring story, Howdle said, Stork was the cheapest engineering stock in Europe, PowerGen was UBS's choice in the UK electricity sector and Enterprise offered strong volume and cashflow growth.

UBS said its stock focus list consisted of up to 30 stocks drawn from analysts' key "buy" recommendations across European markets and which were expected to significantly outperform their local markets on a six-to-12 month horizon.
